headline: Analysts signal shift in AI investment strategy as valuation concerns rise
summary: Research firms suggest the initial phase of the AI trade has concluded, noting that absolute value is increasingly difficult to find. Investors are now advised to pivot toward relative value within the technology sector.
why: The AI sector has been a primary driver of global equity market performance, particularly in the US and Asia, due to massive capital expenditure by hyperscalers and hardware manufacturers.

impacts.name: Technology
impacts.why: Changing valuation models for AI-related companies may lead to capital reallocation within the technology sector.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A shift in investor sentiment regarding AI valuations can trigger broad sell-offs or rotations in high-growth technology stocks that have previously benefited from speculative capital inflows.
